Advertisment for the Post of Directors (Project/Operation/
Human Resource Finance) in UJVNL
Applications are invited for the Post of Directors
(Project/Operation/Human Resource/Finance) in Uttarakhand
Jai Vidhut Nigam Ltd. (UJVNL) under the Department of
Energy, Govt. of Uttarakhand, so as to reach the Principal
Secretary, Energy Department, Secretariat Office, Room No.
201, Second Floor, Vishwakarma Bhawan, 4 Subhash Road,
Dehradun within 30 days from the date of publication of
Advertisement. Detailed information regarding these post (Viz.
Recruitment Rules, 2026, Age, Academic Qualification,
Experience, Status of service, period of appointment, ACRs and
Application form etc.) are available on Uttarakhand Govt.
website www.uk.gov.in and UJVNL website www.ujvnl.com.
(R. Meenakshi Sundaram
Principal Secretary
